# Third-party files

- `vosk.js` – [vosk-browser](https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser) 0.0.8 by Ciaran O'Reilly, Apache-2.0.
  Speech recognition in the browser (WebAssembly build of [Vosk](https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api)).
- `../models/en-small.tar.gz` – `vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15` from [alphacephei.com/vosk/models](https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models), Apache-2.0.
